title: Fallout Shelter Showdown
description: A woman in a transparent raincoat and polka-dot dress holds a film reel toward a shirtless, muscular man with a scarred torso and blue pants. They stand in a dilapidated, graffiti-covered room filled with scattered film reels, broken frames, and Fallout-themed posters.
prompt: A tense confrontation in a destroyed Fallout vault room covered in colorful graffiti reading 'G#1970 FALLOUT SHELTER G#2028'. A woman wearing a transparent raincoat over a polka dot dress holds a film reel toward a shirtless muscular man with scars and blue jeans. The wet floor is littered with broken picture frames, film slides, and movie posters. Cinematic lighting with hanging bulbs and neon tubes, highly detailed digital painting.
